issues.extracted: Charges for services/reimbursements 1,093,736 split into Landfill 912,722 (Utility Charges), Street 74,956 (reimbursements/refunds), Parks 34,609 and Pool 59,402 (Recreation Fees), Library 2,522 and Community Building 9,525 (charges for services/fees)
issues.on_page: Charges for services/reimbursements 1,093,736 (Total Governmental Funds, p6); fund rows on Sch 2 p12, Sch 4 p14, Sch 12-14 and 16 pp24-26, 28
issues.issue: Each piece is a printed fund-schedule row, the split is marked split_from, and it adds up exactly to 1,093,736. The extractor rules, however, say statement receipts come from the Total column and are only split by fund column for tax-type pieces. This is a judgment call between that rule and the printed-breakdown split rule.

This is a mixed line. The Statement of Activities (p2) counts it in Public works Charges for Services (98,923 = 74,956 + 23,967). The matching detail line (detail[62]) has detail_category 'other charges for services', which does not agree with the receipt category. Charges for services could be the better category. It is already marked review.

The report does not name the grantor. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows these as Operating Grants and Contributions. The same choice is used on detail[8], [25], [105], [117] and [157]. Defensible, and already marked review.

issues.on_page: Interest and other income 88,668 (Sch 23 p37: 'Interest and miscellaneous income')
issues.issue: The line mixes interest with other income and has no breakdown. Interest was taken as the main part. It is already marked review.

Every other capital outlay detail line is labelled 'Capital Outlay: <function>' with the function in computed, as the user's capital outlay rule requires. This Bond Fund line has neither. The amount is 0, so only the label is affected.

issues.on_page: Restricted for economic development / capital projects / debt service / consumers' deposits; Unrestricted
issues.issue: Only the two Net Investment in Capital Assets lines have a category. The restricted and unrestricted net position lines have none, while other reports categorize equity lines. The amounts are correct.
